sloka: आदित्यम् इव कालेन युगान्ते भुवि पातितम् ।महेन्द्रम् इव दुर्धर्षम् उपेन्द्रम् इव दुस्सहम् ॥४-१७-१०॥
transliteration: ādityam iva kālena yugānte bhuvi pātitam ।mahendram iva durdharṣam upendram iva dussaham ॥4-17-10॥

translations.english: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.
translations.hindi: ह उन राजसिंह और घर्मबत्सस राजा भरत के राज्यकाल सें किस पुरुष में सामर्थ्य है, जो धर्मविरुद्ध कोई कर्म कर सके?
